versions.subject: New Rules + Update
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith:
        - \powershell.exe
        - \pwsh.exe
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' -e '
        - ' -en '
        - ' -enc '
        - ' -enco'
        - ' -ec '
filter:
    CommandLine|contains: ' -Encoding '
condition: selection and not filter
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\powershell.exe", "*\\pwsh.exe") CommandLine IN ("* -e *", "* -en *", "* -enc *", "* -enco*", "* -ec *") NOT CommandLine="* -Encoding *"

versions.subject: fix: FPs with Azure hosts
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith:
        - \powershell.exe
        - \pwsh.exe
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' -e '
        - ' -en '
        - ' -enc '
        - ' -enco'
        - ' -ec '
filter:
    CommandLine|contains: ' -Encoding '
filter_azure:
    ParentImage|contains:
        - 'C:\Packages\Plugins\Microsoft.GuestConfiguration.ConfigurationforWindows\'
        - '\gc_worker.exe'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter*
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\powershell.exe", "*\\pwsh.exe") CommandLine IN ("* -e *", "* -en *", "* -enc *", "* -enco*", "* -ec *") NOT (CommandLine="* -Encoding *" OR ParentImage IN ("*C:\\Packages\\Plugins\\Microsoft.GuestConfiguration.ConfigurationforWindows\\*", "*\\gc_worker.exe*"))
